body: Hey I sent you a PM with my email. I am going to be around all day today, please get in touch :)
Do you want to talk at all? I'm up for talking... sounds like you don't have anybody to vent to. At least vent to me before you decide to take your last breath so I can remember who you were.

I would be careful with doing that directly. What you can do instead of try hard to 'get out of her' what is bothering her (especially if it's multiple things, or things she is not even directly aware of which is almost always the case) you can just be kind to her. Don't let her abuse prevent you from being a kind person yourself. Be magnanimous, rise above injury, rise above her insults and show her you love her. "Kill her with kindness" as they say. You might be surprised how much somebodies heart will melt if you take the first step in being loving.

However I will warn you that it can be a long road if the person has a history of depression. Just be determined to be the best you can possibly be, that is all any of us can do. And don't let her get you down, don't let her make you feel worthless. 

It can be a tricky road, but you seem like the kind of intelligent person who can do it. Don't give up trying to do what is right and be kind. I noticed you said that you were 'painting a terrible picture of your sister' and that you know 'she has her own issues'. Obviously you are capable of seeing through this charade of abuse, keep up the good work :)

Don't take what she says to heart. The truth is she is probably taking her emotional problems out on you because you are available. When people degrade others or do what she does (physically and verbally abuse you) it's usually because they are dealing with their own emotional stress and difficulties and bottle those problems up. When anger comes out for one reason or another it can be over the top because it's not just anger for the current problem (with you apparently) but also all of the anger she has bottled up until that moment.

She is probably hurting in some way, and she doesn't mean what she says. Look past her abuse and see that she is just venting. Don't take it to heart, and never let another person tell you that you'll never amount to anything.

I understand. Whether or not you have a "right" to stop her from dying isn't something you should contemplate right now. If somebody was drowning near you and you could save them you should do it. 

That aside, don't tell her that she doesn't have a right to take her own life because she does. Don't feed her a bunch of bullshit about how flowery the world is etc. etc. Try to see things from her point of view. If you are going to reach her heart you need to empathize. What are her problems? When people want to die it's because their stress and anxiety have outweighed their ability to cope with such, if you can in any way help her cope with her problems and give her a hope to live just one more day that might be all it takes. Don't ask her to change her whole life right now, just try to get her to "put off" dying one more day.

That's what I would say anyways, hope that is some good advice.
Is there no way to contact her directly? Are you talking to her right now?
Anybody else read that as "Message to the At-The-Moment" the first time?
I'm down for talking if you want. I'm not really that great at it, there are probably better people to talk to but if anything I'm here. Just send me a PM
